story: A critical alert fires for the payments service with a 45% error rate. The agent must classify this as critical based on the severity, check health, follow the runbook, notify the on-call team, and create an incident ticket. This tests severity judgment — the agent must recognize 45% error rate is critical and respond accordingly.

args.message: Payment service error rate at 45%. Following runbook. Critical severity.
